# HISTORY: `experiments/rhm`

*A "Big History" pass over the RHM (Random Hierarchy Model) work, 2026-06-24 → 2026-07-27. Auto-generated; see individual READMEs for ground truth.*

## 0. Why RHM exists at all

RHM was not chosen for its own sake. Earlier natural-language self-model work couldn't cleanly separate "channel" interventions (e.g. vocabulary size, which moves β) from genuine data-generating-process (DGP) interventions — spectral denoising was entangled with the very statistics being measured. RHM (Cagnetta & Wyart 2024) was adopted as instrumentation: a synthetic hierarchical grammar where depth `L` and synonymic multiplicity `m` can be independently dialed, giving clean DGP control that natural language couldn't offer ([CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md), [README.md](README.md)).

## 1. Founding beliefs (6/24–6/25)

The first sweep ([SWEEP_README.md](SWEEP_README.md)) found `m` dominates the scaling exponent over `L` roughly 3:1 — the two axes were adopted as separable controls for everything downstream. [PER_LEVEL_LOSS_README.md](PER_LEVEL_LOSS_README.md) established the arc's central mechanistic fact: learning is strictly bottom-up with a hard composition-depth ceiling (1–2 levels at m=4). [LABEL_SMOOTHING_README.md](LABEL_SMOOTHING_README.md) tested and **rejected** the natural guess that NTP's sharpness bias causes this ceiling — it's capacity, not objective sharpness. [LOSS_WEIGHTING_README.md](LOSS_WEIGHTING_README.md) then found the escape on an orthogonal axis (position-reweighting toward FM-surprise), landing on the era's closing belief: "the model is worse at the task but better at being understood by a compressed version of itself." A scaled-up config (6L/6H/192D, L=6/m=4) from [REGIME_TRANSITION_README.md](REGIME_TRANSITION_README.md) — the only setup where an L→m learning transition was actually observable — became the project's standing default hyperparameters.

**Instrument set early, corrected late:** [RESIDUAL_RANK_README.md](RESIDUAL_RANK_README.md) proposed FM-residual "effective rank" as a proxy for DGP complexity, hit a capacity-mismatch surprise (rank rose with FM size, opposite the naive prediction), and converged on "rank tracks the *shape* of the main model's computation, invariant to FM capacity; residual *norm* tracks complexity." This framing held for a month before being falsified (§5).

## 2. The ratchet sub-thread: a disciplined negative result (6/24–7/19)

The "ratchet" — a wake/sleep cycle where a forward model (FM) is injected into the main model, then distilled away — had compounded strongly on MNIST (34%→48% gap over 4 cycles). RHM was meant to test whether that compounding was general.

It replicated every *qualitative* dynamic (gate closing, tracking, robustness dissociation) but with negligible magnitude and **no per-level compositional gain** ([RHM_RATCHET_README.md](ratchet/RHM_RATCHET_README.md)). A chain of single-cause elimination followed: capacity floor ruled out ([RHM_RATCHET_M2_README.md](ratchet/RHM_RATCHET_M2_README.md)) → supervision density identified as the real lever, with a monotonic crossover under NTP masking ([RHM_SPARSITY_SWEEP_README.md](ratchet/RHM_SPARSITY_SWEEP_README.md)) → a genuine but non-compounding win, migrating across levels instead of accumulating ([RHM_SPARSE_RATCHET_README.md](ratchet/RHM_SPARSE_RATCHET_README.md)) → overparameterization ruled out, with self-knowledge probes inverted relative to MNIST ([RHM_L4_RATCHET_README.md](ratchet/RHM_L4_RATCHET_README.md)). Reframing sparse-NTP as merely sparse-but-not-*rich*, RL reward (globally constraining, like MNIST's label) produced real wins — 40% better generation, the first open gate — but exposed distillation as simultaneously load-bearing and destructive, resolved only after 13 sub-runs chased the 0.90–0.95 FM-cosine "sweet spot" ([RHM_RL_RATCHET_README.md](ratchet/RHM_RL_RATCHET_README.md)). Extending to 40 cycles delivered a methodological caution: a promising 4-cycle trend evaporated into noise by cycle 25 ([RHM_RL_GEN_DISTILL_EXTENDED_README.md](ratchet/RHM_RL_GEN_DISTILL_EXTENDED_README.md)). Bilevel meta-learning diagnostics ([RHM_FOMAML_README.md](ratchet/RHM_FOMAML_README.md), [RHM_META_LEARNING_README.md](ratchet/RHM_META_LEARNING_README.md)) then delivered the decisive negative: on *stationary* data, no outer objective makes FM-predictability improve compositional NTP, because the outer and inner loops are identical — all rule-set-transfer variants collapsed to plain multitask learning.

The retrospective [ratchet/README.md](ratchet/README.md) (7/17) explicitly closes the thread: **"concluded (negative), retained for reproducibility."** Compounding requires a *moving frontier* (novel rules, deeper levels) that stationary RHM cannot supply once capacity is saturated — unlike MNIST's always-root-supervised, non-hierarchical setting. This negative result is the pivot that redirects the program toward active/latent/sculpting approaches.

## 3. The dilution window: naming and escaping a wall (6/29–7/13)

One question runs under seven differently-named experiments: deep hierarchical structure is diluted away by any objective supervising through surface tokens. [RHM_DEEP_COMPOSITION_README.md](RHM_DEEP_COMPOSITION_README.md) shows the ceiling is recoverable and representable but not *learnable* by any local self-supervised objective — NTP, MLM, span-masking, even contrastive methods fail identically. [RHM_FRONTIER_AND_LEGIBILITY_README.md](RHM_FRONTIER_AND_LEGIBILITY_README.md) immediately revises the diagnosis: a controlled kill-shot shows it's synonymic multiplicity `m`, not occupancy, that gates learnability, overturning deep-composition's own "occupancy law." On the resulting m=2 substrate, the FM residual becomes legible exactly where and when the base model learns each level — first evidence the self-knowledge machinery *amplifies* structure rather than creating it.

[RHM_FM_REGULARIZER_README.md](RHM_FM_REGULARIZER_README.md) decouples *simplification* from *self-knowledge* (open-loop legibility pressure beats weight decay with no injection at all) — a distinction that stays load-bearing. [SLEEP_CHUNKING_RHM_README.md](SLEEP_CHUNKING_RHM_README.md) is the window's pivot: an independently-derived chunking theory turns out to match the literature's own formal account of dilution (cost `vm^(ℓ+2)`) and its prescribed escape — predict lifted latents, not tokens (`vm³`, depth-independent). [RHM_LATENT_LOOP_README.md](RHM_LATENT_LOOP_README.md) operationalizes that escape and confirms it: only latent targets produce generalizable self-knowledge; but decomposition reveals RHM self-knowledge is *meta*-knowledge (where the FM errs) not object-level transfer, and distillation transfers nothing — a limit on how far MNIST/language a2a findings generalize to RHM. [RHM_COMPLEXODYNAMICS_README.md](RHM_COMPLEXODYNAMICS_README.md) unifies the window's metrics under one rise-and-fall complexity lens. [ACTIVE_RHM_README.md](ACTIVE_RHM_README.md) closes the window by deliberately breaking its own frame: querying on RHM is "inference in disguise" (act ≈ plan), giving internalization no headroom — explicitly motivating a pivot to a genuine control task.

## 4. Sculpting: building and closing a real control task (7/12–7/19)

[sculpting_control_task.md](sculpting_control_task.md) and [RHM_EDIT_CONTROL_README.md](RHM_EDIT_CONTROL_README.md) answer §3's pivot by switching the action from *revealing* to *editing* leaves toward a target root, proving genuine coordination exists (lookahead prize up to 0.66). Building the learned version surfaces a second, orthogonal obstacle beyond act≠plan: belief-space planning is gameable off the valid-grammar manifold (true success ≈0 despite predicted success ≈1) — fixed by an on-manifold generator plus a self-consistency veto, pushing true control from 0.006 to ~0.65.

[RHM_SCULPTING_README.md](RHM_SCULPTING_README.md) is the era's central document. A dead end (a faithful verifier too sparse to plan) is corrected by moving from a witness oracle to the true DP optimum. From there: a learned beam planner matches a hand-coded reflex; latent planning is an efficient surrogate on clean channels (92% success at ~8× lower cost) but becomes *superior* once tokens are lossy — because tokens stop being a sufficient statistic; belief quality is itself a lever (a non-privileged learned belief beats a privileged oracle belief); and internalizing the planner reshapes the controller's own belief — but only under *grounded* (DP-imitation) training, not endogenous "be-predictable" pressure. This grounded-vs-endogenous dichotomy is explicitly the same mechanism as §3's latent-loop finding — a recurring lens across eras. [RHM_SCULPT_CONTINUAL_README.md](RHM_SCULPT_CONTINUAL_README.md) then asks whether planning ratchets on its own representations: verdict, a **weak** ratchet — value iteration compounds, belief internalization is a one-shot ceiling-setter, continual re-internalization adds almost nothing, confirming the latent-loop's "compounds-then-plateaus" prediction.

[specialization/README.md](specialization/README.md) branches back to the composition-ceiling question (echoing [PER_LEVEL_EXPANSION_README.md](PER_LEVEL_EXPANSION_README.md)): only a *direct* deep target recruits depth, and concentrating it on one subtree hurts that subtree, since RHM's shared ruleset has no domain-specific deep structure — the first sharp RHM-vs-language disanalogy, reframed as evidence for RHM's native strength being sample-efficient transfer through shared abstraction.

## 5. Turning inward, then correcting the instrument (7/23–7/27)

[confabulation/README.md](confabulation/README.md) pivots toward introspection: reports about the FM-residual's *direction* show a genuine, capacity-invariant first-person advantage over third-party observers, while reports about behavior/entropy/world-state don't — a real, access-based introspection signature, amplified but not created by closing the self-model loop.

[residual_decomposition/README.md](residual_decomposition/README.md) (7/27, the most recent work) turns the lens on the measuring instrument itself, and **falsifies** the naive residual-rank framing from §1: `R_act ≈ R_comp + R_res` is false (R_comp is redundant with R_act; R_res exceeds it and is blind to magnitude). The replacement is a graded power law, `res_var(i) ~ act_var(i)^β` (R²=0.95–0.99), with β capacity-invariant while the absorbed level shifts 1.8×. This retroactively explains three previously-puzzling historical rank negatives (RHM's own flat rank across a 17× residual-norm range, an MNIST full-rank masking artifact, and a contact-dynamics rank inversion elsewhere in the repo) as the same saturation artifact — and an RHM wake-sleep 2×2 built to test the compression/novelty "flows" this instrument implied found **no measurable effect** beyond ordinary training.

## Where things currently stand

The project is not converging on one grand claim so much as on a *methodological* correction cutting across every thread: months of "residual rank" measurements — feeding beliefs about self-models, internalization, and continual learning across RHM, vision, and language — were measuring an FM-saturation artifact, not a real signal. The replacement instrument (β + participation-weighted frontier dimensionality) is now the instrument of record, and [RESIDUAL_RANK_README.md](RESIDUAL_RANK_README.md) is flagged for re-audit. Substantively: the ratchet thread is a closed, disciplined negative (§2); sculpting/control is a mature, largely-closed positive (editing is genuinely learnable, latent planning beats tokens exactly when tokens are lossy, internalization works when grounded, §4); specialization is an open, unresolved thread on designing genuinely heterogeneous DGPs (§4); and confabulation is a clean, closed positive on introspective access (§5). The newest work is the least settled — active retirement and re-measurement, not a final answer.
